card.name: Unintentional or accidental overdose wording
card.fires_on: The word "unintentional" (its pieces "unintention" and "al") and sometimes "accidental", right after intentional, self-harm or suicide in overdose and exposure passages.

modes.label: Start of unintentional
modes.description: The first piece of "unintentional" after "or" or "and" following intentional self-harm.
modes.example: The excessive intake of acetaminophen may be intentional to cause self-harm or<< unintention>>al as patients attempt to obtain more pain

modes.label: End of unintentional
modes.description: The closing piece of the word, finishing it after "unintention" or "Unint".
modes.example: The excessive intake of acetaminophen may be intentional to cause self-harm or unintention<<al>> as patients attempt to obtain more pain relief

modes.label: Accidental after suicide
modes.description: The word "accidental" paired with suicide attempts before overdoses.
modes.example: have been reported in suicide attempts and<< accidental>> overdoses.

card.writes: The promoted tokens suggest error or mistake words (误, 失误), but the output effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It lights up on "unintentional" or "accidental" when a label contrasts overdose on purpose with overdose by mistake.
